snippet.title: My Brother Sammy Is Special Read Aloud Book, Bilingual Books, Spanish & English Children Books
snippet.description:
Welcome to Teacher Toast! Our learning environment is here to provide you teachers, parents and caregivers, many of the most entertaining story books for your children. Books that will help your children learn to read, to relate, develop relationships, awareness, emotions, and self-expression, all through these wonderful tales and illustrations. 

About this Book: 
Sammy does not go to school with his older brother—Sammy has to go to school on a special bus. The brothers cannot play in the park together—Sammy lies under the tree and watches the leaves. Sammy’s brother is angry because Sammy is autistic and does not know how to be a “normal” brother. Then, one day, Sammy’s older brother realizes that he should not demand everything on his own terms and that Sammy’s way of doing things may not be so bad after all. Keep readingto learn more about Sammy!

Make sure to visit the publishing company, author and illustrator for more incredible books like this one!
Publisher: Sky Pony
Author: Becky Edwards
Illustrator: David Armitage - https://www.davidarmitage.com/

snippet.description:
Michael Jackson's Daughter Paris Jackson Exposes The Truth & What She Saw Behind Closed Doors

It was touted as the most magical childhood home on Earth. Ferris wheels turning. Train tracks winding through the estate. Unlimited freedom.

Let's get into it.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Children in Neverland on ML King's Bday
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson RARE Children visiting Neverland on Martin Luther King's Birthday English subtitles
January 17, 1994 
Michael Jackson opened his Neverland Ranch in a Martin Luther King Day celebration for 100 inner-city children who excelled in school.
Jackson spent Saturday mingling with the children, posing for photographs and signing autographs. The children watched the movie "Beethoven's 2nd" in Jackson's theater and then visited his amusement park and zoo.
"This was a reward for them, and especially on the birthday of Martin Luther King Jr., it is a very special occasion. These kids will never forget.
